level.description: The rune level this stat spread costs on this class.

stats_given.description: Stats the caller specified. Everything else was filled from the class.

stats_from_class_minimum.description: Stats nobody chose. Say so when reporting a build: these are the class's floor, not a decision.

stats_raised_to_class_minimum.description: Stats the caller asked for below this class's floor, which came back raised to it. Say so: the user did not get the number they named.

class_level.description: The rune level this class begins at, before any point is spent. Wretch starts at 1, Hero at 7.

points_spent.description: Stat points above the class's starting spread.

target_level.description: The target that was asked for, or 0 if none was.

levels_to_target.description: target_level minus level: how many levels are left to spend. Negative means the build already costs more than the target. Zero when no target was given.

optimal_class.description: The class that reaches the specified stats at the lowest rune level.

optimal_class_level.description: The rune level those same stats cost on that class. Comparable to `level`.

levels_saved_by_optimal_class.description: level minus optimal_class_level. Zero when this class is already optimal.

assumed.description: Judgement parameters the caller did not give, and the value the collection used. Empty when the caller gave them all. Quote these as assumptions, never as the user's choice.
